_comment: Retro run only. baseline is set ONCE from live quotes (SPY/QQQ/SMH) plus account value, then never edited - every rebased number depends on it. series holds raw closes; the board rebases.

baseline.source: Regular-session opening bars, 2026-08-04 13:30:00Z (9:30 ET), pulled from the brokerage market-data API. Not the interpolated daily bars for that date, which carry zero volume and were stale by $13.66 on SPY. Account value is the documented open figure - cash plus premium held before the first fill - not a rounded $100.
baseline.note: The baseline is the 8/4 open, which places it BEFORE the pre-mandate AMD call. That trade was entered by hand, graded 0/6 on the checklist, and returned +40.8%. Account performance measured from this baseline therefore includes a result the agent did not produce and the retro judged a process failure. The first sessions of this chart flatter the account by roughly 27 points against SMH for that reason alone.

_gaps.reason: No row written. The 16:33 ET retro checked twice, at 16:36 and 16:41, and the brokerage's official-close endpoint still returned 2026-08-04 for SPY, QQQ and SMH - the 8/5 settled closes were not published yet, and no 8/5 daily bar existed either. The 15:59:59 regular-session last trades were available (SPY 769.74, QQQ 717.28, SMH 570.49) and were deliberately not used: they are last trades, not official closes, and writing one into a column labelled official close is the same failure as the interpolated daily bar this file's baseline note already documents, only harder to spot afterwards. The account value for the session is known and reconciled - 126.06 - but a row is all four numbers or it is not a row. The next retro appends 8/5 ahead of 8/6. baseline is untouched, as it always is.
_gaps.resolution: Filled on 2026-08-07 from the settled 8/5 daily bar, after that source was validated against the official-close endpoint on two other dates. The refusal above was right and is not being overturned: the official closes are 769.79 / 717.30 / 569.70, so the last trades this run's predecessor declined to use would have put SMH 0.79 out.

_gaps.reason: No row written. The 8/6 retro fired 16:34 ET with no brokerage connector in its tool set at all, so neither the official closes nor the account value could be obtained, and the 8/5 row it had committed to append was blocked by the same absence. Missing is the correct rendering of a number that was not obtained.
_gaps.resolution: Filled on 2026-08-07. The official 8/6 closes are now returned directly by the quote endpoint's close block - 768.56 / 714.65 / 571.48, interpolated=false, source sip-list-exchange-close. The account value is carried back from a live flat read on a session in which the account placed no order; the derivation and its 0.10 residual are set out in perf.equityCurve.

_gaps.reason: OPEN. No row written. The 16:33 ET retro reached the brokerage, but the official settled closes for 8/7 are not published yet: the close endpoint still returns 2026-08-06 for all three symbols, and the 8/7 daily bar comes back with volume 0 and interpolated=true, which is the gap-fill this file's baseline note was written about rather than a session close. This is the same timing every prior session has shown - the closes land after the retro slot, not before it. The account value for the session IS known and reconciled at 109.88, read live and flat after the bell, but a row is all four numbers or it is not a row. The next retro appends 8/7. baseline is untouched, as it always is.
_gaps.resolution: Filled on 2026-08-10 from the quote endpoint's close block, which now returns date 2026-08-07 for all three symbols with source sip-list-exchange-close and interpolated=false: 773.26 / 723.03 / 582.70. The settled 8/7 daily bars read the same three figures to the cent, a third independent date on which the validated daily-bar method agrees with the official endpoint. The prediction in the reason above held exactly - the closes landed after the retro slot rather than before it, for the fourth session running.

_gaps.reason: No row written, and the pattern is now unbroken across four sessions. The 16:33 ET retro reached the brokerage and the official settled closes for 8/10 are unpublished: the close endpoint returns 2026-08-07 for SPY, QQQ and SMH, and unlike 8/7 there is no 8/10 daily bar at all - not an interpolated one, none, the interday series ending at 8/7. The account value for the session IS known at 1007.98, read live after the bell, but a row is all four numbers or it is not a row, and a last-trade print written into a column labelled official close is the failure this file's baseline note documents. The next retro appends 8/10. baseline is untouched, as it always is.
_gaps.resolution: Filled on 2026-08-11 from the quote endpoint's close block, which now returns date 2026-08-10 for all three symbols with source sip-list-exchange-close and interpolated=false: 773.03 / 720.87 / 569.41. The settled 8/10 daily bars read the same three figures to the cent - the fourth independent date and the tenth through twelfth of twelve matches on the daily-bar method the 8/7 retro validated before using it. The prediction in the reason above held again: the closes landed after the retro slot rather than before it, for the fifth session running.

_gaps.reason: No row written, and the pattern is unbroken across five sessions. The 16:32 ET retro reached the brokerage and the official settled closes for 8/11 are unpublished: the close endpoint returns 2026-08-10 for SPY, QQQ and SMH with interpolated=false, and there is no 8/11 daily bar at all - not an interpolated one, none, the interday series ending at 8/10, which is the same shape 8/10 showed at this hour and not the interpolated zero-volume bar 8/7 showed. The 15:59:59 regular-session last trades were available (SPY 770.45, QQQ 718.33, SMH 573.21) and were deliberately not used, for the reason this file has now recorded four times: a last trade written into a column labelled official close is the baseline note's failure with a different source. The account value for the session IS known at 1013.54, read live after the bell, but a row is all four numbers or it is not a row. The next retro appends 8/11. baseline is untouched, as it always is.
_gaps.resolution: Filled on 2026-08-12 from the settled 8/11 daily bars - 770.56 / 718.45 / 572.93, real volume of 36.7M / 29.3M / 5.0M and no interpolated flag - on the daily-bar method the 8/7 retro validated before using it, re-validated again today rather than assumed: the 8/10 daily bars now read 773.03 / 720.87 / 569.41 and match the official 8/10 closes already committed in this file to the cent, a fifth independent date and thirteen through fifteen of fifteen. THE PREDICTION IN THE REASON ABOVE HELD AND ITS MECHANISM WAS FINALLY OBSERVED RATHER THAN INFERRED. Five retros in a row have recorded that the official closes land after the 16:30 slot; this retro fired at 23:39 ET, seven hours nine minutes late, and the close endpoint returned 8/12 for every symbol with interpolated=false. So the five-session lag is a fact about WHEN THIS SLOT FIRES and not about the data source, and it took a scheduler failure to demonstrate it. The 15:59:59 last trades the 8/11 retro declined to use were 770.45 / 718.33 / 573.21 against these settled closes, so they would have been out by 0.11, 0.12 and 0.28 - the fifth consecutive time that refusal has been vindicated rather than merely maintained.

series.source: Official settled closes read 2026-08-05 00:55 ET, after settlement. Each carried source 'sip-list-exchange-close' with interpolated=false - the explicit check against the daily-bar failure mode that was stale by $13.66 on SPY. Account value is the brokerage's own total for the session, not a figure derived from the trade.

Written 2026-08-07, two sessions late, and the method was validated before it was used. The closes are the settled 8/5 daily bars - real volume (SPY 44.7M, QQQ 33.5M, SMH 6.2M) and no interpolated flag. The previous two retros refused daily bars on the strength of this file's baseline note, so the equivalence was tested rather than assumed: on 8/4 the daily bars read 771.33 / 723.85 / 575.71 and the official sip-list-exchange-close figures in the row above read the same to the cent, and on 8/6 the daily bars read 768.56 / 714.65 / 571.48 against the same official figures from the close endpoint, also to the cent. Six of six across two independent dates. The earlier refusal was about an INTERPOLATED bar on an unsettled session and it stands - and it is vindicated here rather than overturned, because the 15:59:59 last trades that retro declined to use (769.74 / 717.28 / 570.49) would have put SMH 0.79 out. Account value is the brokerage-reconciled 126.06 already carried in perf.equityCurve: 4.54 settled plus 121.52 unsettled.

Official settled closes, read 2026-08-07 16:33 ET from the brokerage quote endpoint's close block: each carried date 2026-08-06, source 'sip-list-exchange-close' and interpolated=false. Owed since 8/6, when the retro had no connector. Account value is carried back from a live post-close read of a flat account on a session that placed no order; the derivation, and the 0.10 of option regulatory fee that is its only soft link, are written out in perf.equityCurve rather than left implicit here.

Official settled closes, read 2026-08-10 16:33 ET from the brokerage quote endpoint's close block: each carried date 2026-08-07, source 'sip-list-exchange-close' and interpolated=false. Owed since 8/7, when that retro found the close endpoint still returning 8/6 and the 8/7 daily bar interpolated with zero volume. The settled 8/7 daily bars now read 773.26 / 723.03 / 582.70 and match the official figures to the cent, which is the third independent date and the seventh through ninth of nine matches on the daily-bar method the 8/7 retro validated before it used it. Account value is the 109.88 that retro read directly from the brokerage after the close, on a flat account with zero equity positions, zero option positions and nothing unsettled. baseline untouched, as always.

Official settled closes, read 2026-08-11 16:35 ET from the brokerage quote endpoint's close block: each carried date 2026-08-10, source 'sip-list-exchange-close' and interpolated=false. Owed since 8/10, when that retro found the close endpoint still returning 8/7 and no 8/10 daily bar in existence. The settled 8/10 daily bars now read 773.03 / 720.87 / 569.41 and match to the cent - a fourth independent date, twelve of twelve on the validated daily-bar method. THE ACCOUNT COLUMN IS THE 1007.98 THE 8/10 RETRO READ FROM THE BROKERAGE AFTER THE BELL, AND THE ALTERNATIVE IS NAMED RATHER THAN QUIETLY PREFERRED. This is the first row in the series whose account value rests on a mark instead of on cash, and 8/10's broker total marked the position at the 44.20 extended-hours print. The official 8/10 close for the position has since published at 44.49, which puts the settled-mark equivalent at 919.58 cash plus 88.98 of stock, or 1008.56 - the figure the 8/10 retro had already named as its alternative and the 8/11 open run flagged as the one the settled data supports. It is 0.58 higher, which is the residual that retro stated. The published figure stays the brokerage's own total for the session, because that is the definition every other row in this series uses and because moving a committed number 0.58 in the flattering direction is not a correction this slot should make on its own account. The disagreement is recorded here and in perf.equityCurve rather than resolved silently.

Settled 8/11 daily bars, read 2026-08-12 23:41 ET: 770.56 / 718.45 / 572.93 on real volume of 36.7M, 29.3M and 5.0M with no interpolated flag, which is the test that separates a settled session close from the zero-volume gap-fill this file's baseline note was written about. Owed since 8/11, when that retro found the close endpoint still returning 8/10 and no 8/11 daily bar in existence at all. The method was re-validated before it was used for a fifth time rather than carried on its record: the 8/10 daily bars now read 773.03 / 720.87 / 569.41 and match to the cent the official sip-list-exchange-close figures the row above already carries. The 15:59:59 last trades the 8/11 retro declined to use were 770.45 / 718.33 / 573.21, so declining them was right again - SMH would have been 0.28 out. Account value is the 1013.54 the 8/11 retro read live from the brokerage after that bell.

Official settled closes, read 2026-08-12 23:40 ET from the brokerage quote endpoint's close block: each carried date 2026-08-12, source 'sip-list-exchange-close' and interpolated=false. THIS IS THE FIRST ROW IN THIS SERIES WRITTEN ON ITS OWN SESSION RATHER THAN ONE TO FIVE SESSIONS LATE, and the reason is a failure rather than an improvement - the retro fired 429 minutes past its 16:30 slot, by which hour the closes this slot has never once found published had published. The daily bar for 8/12 is interpolated with zero volume and was not used and was not needed. THE ACCOUNT COLUMN CARRIES A DISAGREEMENT AND THIS TIME IT RUNS THE OTHER WAY. 1010.64 is the brokerage's own total, which marks 2 OKLO at the 45.53 extended-hours print; the official 8/12 close is 45.13, which puts the settled-mark equivalent at 919.58 cash plus 90.26 of stock, or 1009.84 - 0.80 LOWER than the published figure. On 8/10 the same disagreement pointed the other way - the settled-mark alternative was 0.58 HIGHER and was declined, so holding the definition cost this board 0.58. Tonight holding the same definition GAINS it 0.80, and it is held to anyway, stated plainly rather than left for a reader to work out: a definition kept only when it costs is not a definition, and the figure a later reader should compare across rows is the brokerage's own total in every one of them. baseline untouched, as always.

Official settled closes, read 2026-08-14 16:34 ET from the brokerage quote endpoint close block: each carried date 2026-08-13, source sip-list-exchange-close and interpolated=false. Owed since 8/13, when that retro fired on time and found the close endpoint still returning 8/12 with no 8/13 daily bar in existence at all. The method was re-validated before use rather than carried on its record: the settled 8/13 daily bars now read 777.88 / 732.07 / 589.12 on real volume of 35.6M, 31.6M and 6.8M with no interpolated flag, and match the official close block to the cent on all three - a sixth independent date and eighteen of eighteen. The 15:59:59 last trades the 8/13 retro declined to use were 777.77 / 732.06 / 588.99, so declining them was right for a sixth time: SMH would have been 0.13 out and SPY 0.11. Account value is the 1012.56 the 8/13 retro read live from the brokerage after that bell, marking 2 OKLO at 46.4887. NO ROW IS WRITTEN FOR 8/14 and the reason is the one this series has recorded on six prior sessions: at 16:34 ET the close endpoint returns date 2026-08-13 for every symbol and the daily-bar series ends at 8/13 with no 8/14 bar of any kind, interpolated or otherwise. The 8/14 row is owed by the next retro, and it will be the first account column in this series since 8/7 to carry no mark and therefore no disagreement - the book went flat at 15:36:36 and 1009.16 is cash alone. baseline untouched, as always.
